scope: Read-only inventory of retained November 19 Devnet community snapshot inputs and current prospective archive implementation; no RPC, signing, funding, transaction, deployment or live claim

retainedInputs.migrationReceipts: Finalized canonical initialization receipts retained separately for all three mints

qualification.retainedWalletRows: Snapshot accounts are wallet and balance aggregates, without token account public keys, program owners, raw bytes or a complete account-bank provenance proof.
qualification.rootLimit: Recomputing a retained root proves consistency of the retained aggregates; it does not prove that the original eligibility bank was complete.
qualification.currentRpcLimit: A present-day minContextSlot is a lower bound, not a historical bank selector; current balances cannot be substituted.
qualification.prospectiveCapture: The merged source can retain future raw finalized inputs and verify them after restart, but cannot synthesize the missing original bank or replay blocks.
qualification.status: Historical exact-bank qualification unavailable from inspected local evidence; existing expired windows cannot be reopened. Configured-program 28/28 live delivery remains unverified.

acceptableReadOnlyInputs: An authenticated complete finalized raw token-account bank and mint state at the exact migration slot, with identity, owner, layout, zero/closed handling and supply completeness.
The original atomic finalized raw base at the recorded base slot plus every produced finalized parent-linked block and token pre/post metadata back to the requested canonical migration transaction.
nextAction: If an existing immutable capture or historical-bank provider is identified, ingest it through the existing archive validator, regenerate balances, manifest and root offline, and have independent QA verify provenance and all rejections. A new live 28-recipient configured-program delivery would be a separate scoped financial operation requiring its own quote and approval.
acceptance: Dependency inventory only; no historical bank, current-program financial delivery or Mainnet release acceptance
